description: Audit a parcel against USDA NRCS SSURGO soil survey databases to detect Greenbelt agricultural productivity misclassifications, soil capability classes (Classes I–VIII), and calculate statutory present-use land overcharges under T.C.A. § 67-5-1008 (Exhibit G).

format.description: Output format: 'json' (default) or 'html' for ready-to-file Exhibit G

greenbelt_enrolled.description: Whether the parcel is enrolled in Greenbelt present-use valuation

jurisdiction.description: County or jurisdiction name (e.g. Hamilton, Knox, Sevier, Blount)

name: audit_parcel_soil_capability
